title: Gaussian dynamics in the double Siegel disk
summary: We show that deterministic multimode Gaussian channels admit a symmetric-space description. Passing from the n-mode Siegel disk to a doubled version of that space lets general Gaussian dynamics act by a linear-fractional (Mobius) transformation on a single matrix parameter. This doubled disk naturally parametrizes Gaussian kernels in the Fock-Bargmann representation, and contains an explicit physical subset corresponding to valid mixed Gaussian states.
